name: Ben Shelton
intro: Ben Shelton is a big, smiling lefty from Atlanta, Georgia. A lefty hits with the left hand. His serve can zoom past 150 miles per hour!
story: Ben did not travel the world as a kid. He went to college in Florida and won the national title there. His dad, Bryan, was a pro player and is now his coach. This year Ben won trophies on hard courts, clay, and grass. On Friday night he beat Denis Shapovalov, so he plays again Sunday.

funFacts.text: His serve can hit 150 miles per hour. That is faster than a car on the highway!
Before tennis, his first love was American football.
He loves movie theater slushies and popcorn.
He has never been to a concert in his life. He likes quiet nights in.
He won the college national championship for the Florida Gators in 2022.
His sister Emma played college tennis too. His mom was a top junior player.
He won the big Canada tournament two years in a row. Rafael Nadal was the last to do that.

watchFor: Look for his phone move, when he pretends to hang up an old phone.
